# Dither Icons

> 68 original SVG icons with fine ordered dither and individually authored semantic motion. React 18+, MIT.

## Start here

- [Complete integration guide](/llms-full.txt): API, examples, behavior and valid exports.
- [Agent contract](/AI.md): concise instructions for integrating the library.
- [Icon manifest](/icons.json): schema version 1; exact names, exports, keywords and motion metadata.

## Documentation

- [A good place to start.](/docs/introduction.md): A small library with a particular point of view. Here’s how to make it part of yours.
- [In your project in minutes.](/docs/installation.md): A React package from npm. A standalone SVG for everywhere else.
- [React, without ceremony.](/docs/react.md): Named components, ordinary SVG props, and a few deliberate controls for motion.
- [Motion with a meaning.](/docs/motion.md): A short action, a clear response, and an exact return to rest.
- [A little delight. For everyone.](/docs/accessibility.md): The interaction should still make sense with a keyboard, a screen reader, or no motion at all.
- [Take the drawing with you.](/docs/svg.md): Transparent, scalable, and ready for places where React isn’t part of the picture.

## Visual references

- [Material comparison](/reference/textures.svg)
- [All icons with export names](/reference/icons.svg)

## Installation status

Version 0.1.2. Install with `npm install @unlocalhosted/dither-icons`.
